tags.notes: Rio's intermunicipal network has no open GTFS to repoint to. This was the Fetranspor build and its last version imported in 2016; the host is a Tomcat 7 app that now 500s on every other path. DETRO/RJ regulates the service but publishes only company and itinerary pages, no open data section, and the academic portal that republished Fetranspor data stopped at a 2021 snapshot.
